entities.name: Query IspD/IspF
observations: 398 aa bacterial protein; predicted molecular mass 41.45 kDa and theoretical pI 6.38.
Sequence matches bifunctional IspD/IspF homologs with 46.8–51.9% identity and 98.7–99.5% query coverage; best E-value 9.32e-101.
Pfam domains: IspD (PF01128) at residues 6–235, NTP_transf_3 (PF12804) at residues 5–139, and YgbB (PF02542) at residues 245–397.
No signal peptide or transmembrane segment is indicated by the soluble, enzyme-like sequence composition; intracellular localization is inferred, not experimentally established.

entities.name: MEP cytidylyltransferase reaction
observations: 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 4-phosphate plus CTP forms 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol and diphosphate; associated with EC 2.7.7.60 and Rhea RHEA:13429.

entities.name: ME-CPP synthase reaction
observations: 4-CDP-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2-phosphate forms 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclic diphosphate and CMP; associated with EC 4.6.1.12 and Rhea RHEA:23864.

entities.name: MEP isoprenoid pathway
observations: The inferred enzyme supplies steps 2 and 4 of the methylerythritol 4-phosphate pathway for isopentenyl diphosphate and terpenoid biosynthesis.

entities.name: Divalent metal cofactor
observations: Close reviewed IspD/IspF homologs are annotated as requiring a divalent metal cation; this is homolog-based and not directly experimentally established for the query sequence.
